column3: The same left-behind group first offers excuses and speaks what is not in its hearts, supplying the prior stage of 48:15.
It directly states that the divine word is not changed, clarifying the refusal of their request to revise what God had said before.
Its claim of not understanding is boundary evidence for how “they understand only little” can function amid hostile dismissal.
It adds a pattern of self-exculpating future speech grounded in conjecture rather than knowledge.
It reinforces, within the surah, that God's established way admits no alteration.
